title: Per-part packs: a platform's index.json
description: Generated from js/glb.ts PARTS_INDEX_FIELDS: do not edit (npm run check:models -- --write). See docs/models.md.

platform.description: The platform (gun id) the pieces are for.

src.description: Hash of the recipe sources the pieces came from (stale-pack detection).

slots.description: Every build slot seen in the platform's builds.

from.description: The provider list: the first of these build slots that is filled draws the tag (its part's piece; none: the tag is absent); empty: the platform draws it.

file.description: The piece's file under the platform folder (or `_shared/<tag>/<file>.glb` under the parts folder: stored once for every platform).

at.description: The move [forward, up, right] metres from the file's geometry to where the piece sits when no part offsets it.

oneOf.description: The part_ nodes the piece has meshes in.

nodes.description: The part_ nodes the piece has meshes in.

oneOf.description: A stretched piece: the forward position (in the file) of the end it is stretched from.

rear.description: A stretched piece: the forward position (in the file) of the end it is stretched from.

oneOf.description: A stretched piece: its length in the file, metres (signed).

len.description: A stretched piece: its length in the file, metres (signed).

oneOf.description: A stretched piece: its length when no part changes it, metres (signed).

len0.description: A stretched piece: its length when no part changes it, metres (signed).

pieces.description: The pieces: "<slot>=<part>" (or "" for the platform's own), with "#<label>" for a variant.

key.description: The spec key whose value decides.

oneOf.description: Variants: the piece key gets "#<label>", the label being values["<by>=<part>"][key] (or values[""][key]; "none" when the slot is empty).

vary.description: Variants: the piece key gets "#<label>", the label being values["<by>=<part>"][key] (or values[""][key]; "none" when the slot is empty).

oneOf.description: Condition slots: an offset `mount_<tag>?<slot>` applies only while that slot is filled.

cond.description: Condition slots: an offset `mount_<tag>?<slot>` applies only while that slot is filled.

oneOf.description: The piece is stretched along the bore: its length is len0 plus the parts' `len_<tag>` offsets.

stretch.description: The piece is stretched along the bore: its length is len0 plus the parts' `len_<tag>` offsets.

oneOf.description: The tag shows only while values[a] - values[b] > gt (two parts' spec values).

show.description: The tag shows only while values[a] - values[b] > gt (two parts' spec values).

oneOf.description: On one axis the `of` slots' offsets give way to the `by` part's `cap_<tag>` (min or max).

cap.description: On one axis the `of` slots' offsets give way to the `by` part's `cap_<tag>` (min or max).

oneOf.description: On one axis the offset is the min (or max) of two parts' `pair_<tag>` values (instead of the sum).

pair.description: On one axis the offset is the min (or max) of two parts' `pair_<tag>` values (instead of the sum).

tags.description: Per tag (a mesh slot, or slot@anchor for a piece another part places): who draws it and its pieces.

anchors.description: What each part gives: "<slot>=<partId>" -> { mount_<tag>: [f, u, r] offset, mount_<tag>?<slot>: offset while that slot is filled, len_<tag>: length, cap_<tag> / pair_<tag>: value }.

values.description: The spec values variants and thresholds go by: "<slot>=<partId>" (or "" for the platform's own) -> { key: JSON text }.

from.description: The provider list: the first filled slot whose part is not in skip provides the leaf (else the platform).

oneOf.description: Parts ("<slot>=<part>") that do not provide it: the next one down does.

skip.description: Parts ("<slot>=<part>") that do not provide it: the next one down does.

own.description: Each provider's own value ("" the platform's; { "del": 1 }: the leaf is absent).

oneOf.description: The provider key gets "#<label>" as a tag's vary does.

vary.description: The provider key gets "#<label>" as a tag's vary does.

oneOf.description: Per provider slot: the other parts' offsets for the leaf, summed (x: "<slot>=<part>" -> number; y: condition slot -> those, while it is filled).

off.description: Per provider slot: the other parts' offsets for the leaf, summed (x: "<slot>=<part>" -> number; y: condition slot -> those, while it is filled).

oneOf.description: The leaf is the larger of the value and v[the part in `by`].

max.description: The leaf is the larger of the value and v[the part in `by`].

info.description: The `info` leaves (a/b/0 paths): who provides each and how it moves.
